title: Launch HN: OneCLI (YC S26) – OSS sandboxed agent harness for teams
summary: OneCLI is an open-source agent harness designed for teams that provides sandboxed personal AI agents to employees, with built-in integrations to services like GitHub, Gmail, Notion, and Dropbox, plus deterministic human-in-the-loop approval for sensitive operations and centralized team policy management.
problem_solved: Enables enterprises to safely deploy AI agents to employees without security risks, while maintaining control over sensitive actions.
why_valuable: It bridges the gap between AI agent capabilities and enterprise security requirements by providing sandboxed execution environments with mandatory human approval workflows for critical operations.
